entries.title: The Crewmate tab keeps up with a Claude crewmate
entries.body: A task card's Crewmate tab could stop showing what a crewmate on Claude wrote, leaving a line you typed marked queued and the crewmate's answer missing until it wrote again. The tab now shows every line the crewmate has written.
entries.noPicture: The tab looks as it always did; the fix only stops it from keeping an older transcript after the crewmate's session moved on.
